boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Montclair State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with published closing times, spanning campus and nearby Montclair.

cards.title: Bistro 62
cards.subtitle: Sam’s Place, Montclair State University
cards.notes: Check the dining schedule before walking over. This campus option takes over after Sam’s Place closes, making it a practical later-evening stop.
cards.short_summary: A university-documented late campus dining option.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State’s Residence Life page says Bistro 62 opens when Sam’s Place closes and closes at 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: University source states Bistro 62 closes at 1 a.m.; check current dining operations before visiting.

cards.title: Domino's on Glenridge
cards.subtitle: 59 Glenridge Avenue, Montclair
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm today’s closing time, then place a carryout or delivery order through the location’s ordering link.
cards.short_summary: A Montclair pizza location with service listed through 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Domino’s location page lists the Montclair store at 59 Glenridge Avenue as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 59 Glenridge Avenue, Montclair
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists open until 1:00 a.m.; hours and delivery availability can vary.

cards.title: Porta’s Late-Night Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: 499 Bloomfield Avenue, Montclair
cards.notes: For a Friday night food stop, verify the date and order from the late-night pizza offering rather than relying on the restaurant’s general closing time.
cards.short_summary: Friday pizza service is published through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Porta’s official Montclair page lists Friday late-night pizza until 12 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday late-night pizza until 12 a.m.; its dinner and bar hours are separate.

cards.title: Egan & Sons’ Food Menu
cards.subtitle: 116 Walnut Street, Montclair
cards.notes: Go for the food menu and check the kitchen cutoff before heading downtown. The published kitchen schedule is later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Walnut Street kitchen with late Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Egan & Sons’ official site lists kitchen closing at 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday, with the venue open until 1:30 a.m. those nights.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Saturday venue hours until 1:30 a.m.; kitchen closes at 10 p.m. Go for food before that cutoff.

cards.title: 82 Oak’s Late Food Setting
cards.subtitle: Montclair
cards.notes: Confirm seating and the food menu directly before traveling. The business publishes late-night operation, while its event programming can vary.
cards.short_summary: A Montclair bistro that advertises operation through 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: 82 Oak Bar & Bistro’s official site says it is open until 2:00 a.m. for extended celebrations and describes a food menu.
cards.access_notes: Official site states it is open until 2:00 a.m.; contact the business to confirm food-service timing and seating.

cards.title: Nami Nori’s 9:30 Close
cards.subtitle: 378 Bloomfield Avenue, Montclair
cards.notes: Reserve or order takeout before the final seating window. The official location page publishes dinner hours and says takeout and delivery are available during business hours.
cards.short_summary: Hand rolls and takeout with a published 9:30 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Nami Nori’s official Montclair page lists 9:30 p.m. closing on Friday through Sunday and says takeout and delivery are available during business hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday–Sunday service until 9:30 p.m.; takeout and delivery are available during published hours.

cards.title: Diesel and Duke on Church Street
cards.subtitle: 20 Church Street, Montclair
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official ordering route to confirm the day’s service. Friday and Saturday have the latest posted closing time at this location.
cards.short_summary: A Church Street burger shop open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Diesel and Duke’s official site lists its Montclair location at 20 Church Street and Friday–Saturday hours until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours of 12 p.m.–10 p.m.; verify holiday or event changes before visiting.

cards.title: Sapori’s Later Weekend Dinner
cards.subtitle: 9 Park Street, Montclair
cards.notes: Plan a Friday or Saturday dinner reservation if you want the latest published service window. Check the restaurant directly for holiday or special-event changes.
cards.short_summary: Park Street Italian dining published until 10:30 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Sapori Montclair’s official site lists Friday and Saturday hours from 4:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday closing at 10:30 p.m.; reservations and holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The Red Hawk Diner
cards.subtitle: Outside the Student Center, Montclair State University
cards.notes: Check the university’s live dining status before making this an evening plan. The official dining page identifies the diner as a campus venue by the Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A named campus diner listed by Dining Services.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair State Dining Services lists The Red Hawk Diner as a campus dining venue outside the Student Center and describes its diner-style menu.
cards.access_notes: Consult Montclair State’s live dining status for current late hours; the university’s venue page does not publish a fixed closing time.

cards.title: Wendy’s in Clifton
cards.subtitle: 83 Main Avenue, Clifton
cards.notes: This is a drive-oriented option beyond Montclair. Confirm transportation and use the official location page for the current restaurant and drive-thru schedule.
cards.short_summary: A nearby regional chain location with 3 a.m. hours listed daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for 83 Main Avenue in Clifton lists restaurant and drive-thru hours through 3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 3:00 a.m. daily; this requires travel beyond Montclair.
